title: No Filter: Cultural and Socioeconomic Diversity in Contrastive Vision–Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating zero-shot classification performance on geographically and culturally diverse datasets (GLDv2, GeoDE, MaRVL) and introducing a novel few-shot geo-localization task to predict the geographical origin of images.
Disaggregating and comparing zero-shot classification accuracy across different monthly household income brackets using the Dollar Street dataset.
Measuring cross-modal image-text retrieval performance on the multilingual XM3600 dataset to compare models trained on English-only, raw multilingual, and machine-translated image-text pairs.
